child_list.content: The Earthquake
child_list.name: 题目

elements.content:
The earthquake is one of the most severe natural disasters. So it’s important to know how to stay safe on earthquake.

If you are inside, hide under a strong table. This protects you from falling objects. If you are outside, move to an open area. Stay away from buildings and trees, as they can fall during an earthquake. Always have an emergency kit at home. It should include water, food, and a first aid kit. After the shaking stops, check for safe exits.

Earthquakes are powerful, but being prepared helps us stay safe.

child_list.content: 地震
child_list.name: 题目

child_list.content:
地震是最严重的自然灾害之一。所以知道如何在地震中保持安全是很重要的。

如果你在室内，请躲在坚固的桌子下面。这可以保护你不被掉落的东西砸到。如果你在室外，请移动到空旷的地方。远离建筑物和树木。它们会在地震时倒塌。在家里准备一个应急包。里面应该有水、食物和急救箱。地震停止后，检查安全出口。

地震破坏性很强，但做好准备有助于我们保持安全。

地震破坏性很强，但做好准备有助于我们保持安全。
